plugin.note: Bring fungicide spray and refills for the finishing blow. Zygomites use magic-based melee and ranged attacks, so dragonhide or Karil's armour helps with magic defence; Protect from Melee is the simple prayer for regular Zygomites, while Ancient Zygomite trips can use safespots and a Reagent pouch for Mort myre fungus.

requirements: Lost City completion for Zanaris access
Fungicide spray to deliver the final blow
Fungicide refills unless using enough charges already in the spray
'Shroom sprayer unlock for automatic finishing blows when carrying Fungicide spray and Fungicide
Fossil Island access for Mushroom Forest Ancient Zygomites
Custodia Pass access for Stalker Den Ancient Zygomites
mechanics: Zygomites appear as Fungi until picked, then become attackable.
Zygomites and Ancient Zygomites require Fungicide spray below 8 Hitpoints to die.
Fungicide spray must be reloaded every ten kills with Fungicide.
Both regular and ancient variants use magical melee and magical ranged attacks.
Dragonhide armour or Karil's armour reduces incoming damage because the attacks roll against Magic defence.
Protect from Melee is recommended for regular Zygomites because their melee attacks are more accurate.
Ancient Zygomites have stronger and more accurate ranged attacks, so Protect from Missiles is relevant when not safespotting them.
Ancient Zygomites can be safespotted by trapping them and standing at least six tiles away because their ranged attack reaches five tiles.
All attackable Zygomite variants have a 40% fire elemental weakness.
Konar location locks decide whether regular Zanaris Zygomites or Ancient Zygomites can count for the task.

methods.label: Fungicide finisher
methods.summary: Carry Fungicide spray and refills so each Zygomite can be finished after being reduced below 8 Hitpoints.
steps: Buy or bring Fungicide spray before starting the task.
Carry Fungicide refills because the spray must be reloaded every ten kills.
Attack the Zygomite normally until it is under 8 Hitpoints.
Use Fungicide spray to deliver the final blow when it is under 8 Hitpoints.
If 'Shroom sprayer is unlocked, keep Fungicide spray and Fungicide in the inventory so finishing blows happen automatically.
risks: Without Fungicide spray, the monster cannot be killed.
Buying excess Fungicide is wasteful because spray and refills cannot be sold back to Slayer masters.

methods.label: Regular dragonhide melee
methods.summary: Use melee with dragonhide or Karil's armour for Magic defence, praying Protect from Melee when using prayer.
prayers: Piety if using prayer for faster kills
steps: Pick Fungi in Zanaris to provoke Zygomites.
Wear dragonhide or Karil's armour rather than low Magic-defence armour.
Use Protect from Melee if praying against regular Zygomites.
Use melee damage until the target is under 8 Hitpoints.
Finish the kill with Fungicide spray or the automatic 'Shroom sprayer effect.
notes: The task page recommends Protect from Melee for regular Zygomites because their melee attacks are more accurate.

methods.label: Zanaris safespot
methods.summary: At the Cosmic Altar, trap Zygomites on the pillar and stand back near the mysterious ruins to attack safely.
steps: Use the Zanaris area near the Cosmic Altar.
Trap Zygomites on the nearby pillar.
Stand back near the mysterious ruins so the trapped Zygomite cannot reach attack range.
Attack with Ranged until the target is under 8 Hitpoints.
Step in only as needed to apply Fungicide spray or rely on 'Shroom sprayer if unlocked.
risks: Leaving the safespot to finish or loot can put the player back in attack range.
The east-of-furnace location is cannonable but the task page does not mark it safespottable.

methods.label: Ancient Zygomites
methods.summary: Kill Ancient Zygomites in Mushroom Forest or Stalker Den when location locks allow, using safespots and a Reagent pouch for guaranteed Mort myre fungus.
requiredOrKeyItems: Ranged or Magic weapon for safespotting
prayers: Protect from Missiles when tanking Ancient Zygomites
Protect from Melee if fighting regular Zygomites instead
steps: Use Mushroom Forest on Fossil Island or Stalker Den in Custodia Pass when the task location allows Ancient Zygomites.
Pick Ancient Fungi to provoke Ancient Zygomites.
Use a Reagent pouch to store the guaranteed Mort myre fungus drops.
Safespot by trapping Ancient Zygomites and standing at least six tiles away from them.
If tanking instead of safespotting, prioritise Magic defence and consider Protect from Missiles because their ranged attacks are stronger and more accurate.
Finish each Ancient Zygomite with Fungicide spray below 8 Hitpoints.
notes: If Konar assigns Mutated zygomites in Zanaris, Ancient Zygomites do not count.
If Konar assigns the task on Fossil Island, regular Zygomites cannot be killed there, so Ancient Zygomites are required.

methods.label: Fire magic
methods.summary: Use fire spells as a valid alternate style because all attackable Zygomite variants have a 40% fire weakness.
steps: Use fire spells from a safespot or while wearing Magic-defence armour.
Prefer safespots for Ancient Zygomites and the Cosmic Altar regular Zygomites.
Keep Fungicide spray ready because spell damage alone cannot deliver the final kill state.
notes: The monster pages list a 40% fire elemental weakness for regular and Ancient Zygomites.

styleOptions.label: Melee with Magic defence
styleOptions.summary: Melee in dragonhide or Karil's armour with Protect from Melee for regular Zygomites.

styleOptions.label: Ranged safespot
styleOptions.summary: Use Ranged from the Cosmic Altar or Ancient Zygomite safespots, stepping in only to finish if needed.

styleOptions.label: Fire magic
styleOptions.summary: Use fire spells where safespots or Magic training are preferred, exploiting the 40% fire weakness.
